title: Users
description: Search accounts, change roles, and suspend or reactivate users.

detail.rolesHint: Check the complete set of roles. Changes apply with the user's next token (≤ 15 min).
detail.rolesReadOnly: Only an administrator can change roles.
detail.rolesRules: Every user keeps the Student role, and an administrator cannot remove their own role.

suspend.title: Suspend {email}
suspend.warning: All their sessions will be revoked and they won't be able to sign in until the account is reactivated.
suspend.untilHint: Without a date, the suspension is indefinite.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {email}
reactivate.warning: The user will be able to sign in again; their previous sessions are not restored.
